observations.body: Stephen retells bush and Sinai through angelic speech, Moses in the wilderness assembly, living revelations, rejection, calf worship, tent, and law received as ordained by angels but not kept.
observations.label: Stephen remembers angel, assembly, living revelations, calf, and rejected law

observations.body: Stephen remembers angel, assembly, living revelations, calf, and rejected law belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Acts 7:30–53 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Acts 7:30–53 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Stephen remembers angel, assembly, living revelations, calf, and rejected law belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
